description: Use this when a seller asks about a product's specs, fabric, fit, print methods or what is similar to it. Returns curated product facts and similar products with what they share and how they differ. Specs describe the product; they do not promise every supplier offers every option.

canonicalProductId.description: A product id from search_products or resolve_supplier_link, such as `cotton-ringer-tee`.

similarLimit.description: How many similar products to return. 0 skips them.

name: get_product

audience.description: Who the product is made for, such as unisex or mens.

brand.description: The brand, such as Gildan; null when the product has none.

category.description: The category the product belongs to; null when it has none.

description.description: A description of the product in words.

faqs.description: Questions sellers ask about this product.

highlights.description: Short facts about the product, such as fabric and fit.

model.description: The brand's model code, such as `3001`; null when none.

printMethods.description: Print methods the product supports, such as DTG or embroidery.

specs.description: Product specs as label and value, such as `fabric`: `100% cotton`.

url.description: The product's page on POD Benchmark; null when it has none.

similar.description: Other products that could stand in for this one.

differences.description: Where it differs in a way that matters.

sharedTraits.description: What it has in common with the product.

similarity.description: How close it is: close alternative or acceptable substitute.

url.description: The similar product's page on POD Benchmark.

similarCount.description: How many similar products exist in total.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: Read a product's details
